title: Code for: Beyond monthly commuting flows: mobility matrices by age for weekdays, weekends and holidays in South Korea
description: Julia and R code that builds day-type-resolved (weekday, weekend, holiday) commute, non-commute and non-move origin–destination matrices for 250 South Korean districts and 15 age groups, January 2018 – December 2023, by iterative proportional fitting of a public-data initial guess to the registered population and hourly mobile-phone de facto population, with Bayesian calibration of weekend and holiday behaviour.
